item.title: How to Install Claude Code (2026): macOS, Windows, Linux
item.description:
What is Claude Code?

Claude Code is Anthropic’s coding agent that runs in your terminal. It reads your project, edits files and runs commands. You install it once on your machine, then start it with claude in any project folder. Its memory comes from files such as CLAUDE.md and from optional add-ons.

How do you install Claude Code?

Open a terminal and run the command for your system. Anthropic’s native installer is the recommended route, and it keeps itself up to date.

item.title: How to Install Codex CLI (2026): macOS, Windows, Linux
item.description:
To install Codex CLI, run one command for your system. On macOS or Linux, run curl -fsSL https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.sh | sh. On Windows, use the PowerShell line below. Then run codex in a project folder and choose Sign in with ChatGPT. Codex CLI is OpenAI’s coding agent that runs in your terminal, on your own machine.

What is Codex CLI?

Codex CLI is a coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally. It reads the files in your project folder, edits them, and runs the tools already on your machine. It is separate from the Codex web agent at chatgpt.com/codex and from the Codex desktop app. The official README lists the IDE extension, the desktop app (codex app) and the cloud agent as other ways to use Codex.

item.title: How to Install Gemini CLI (2026): npm, Homebrew, GEMINI.md Memory
item.description:
To install Gemini CLI, run one npm command. Run npm install -g @google/gemini-cli, then run gemini in a project folder and sign in with Google. Gemini CLI is Google’s open-source coding agent for the terminal.

What is Gemini CLI?

Gemini CLI is a command-line coding agent from Google. It reads and edits files in your project folder, and it runs commands in your terminal. The official repository is github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli. Read 2026-11-12.
